name: "Gender Reveal" Jello Cups with Whipped Cream & Berries

instructions.primary_message: Make sure you have enough space in your fridge to accommodate a baking sheet pan or tray. Arrange 12 small glasses or plastic cups on a baking sheet or tray.
Fill a large pot with about 8 cups of hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat.
Place each flavor of gelatin in a microwave safe medium bowl, then add 1 1/2 cups of boiling water to each bowl. Whisk until all the gelatin is dissolved, 30-60 seconds for each bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (170 g) pkg gelatin dessert mix, strawberry flavored
1 (170 g) pkg gelatin dessert mix, berry blue-flavored
2 (85 g) pkg gelatin dessert mix, lemon-flavored

instructions.primary_message: Place the bowl with the strawberry gelatin in the fridge to chill until cool but not set, about 10 minutes. (You can leave the other two bowls on the counter to cool.)

When the strawberry gelatin is cool, remove from the fridge. (If the gelatin has started to set, place in the microwave and heat in 10-second intervals, just until it is fully liquid again.) Add yogurt and milk to the bowl, then whisk to combine. Divide between the glasses (about 1/4-cup each), then place the tray in the fridge until the pudding is mostly set, 20-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup vanilla Greek yogurt
½ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: When the strawberry gelatin is set, add yogurt and milk to the bowl with the berry blue gelatin, then whisk to combine. (If the gelatin has started to set, place in the microwave and heat in 10-second intervals, just until it is fully liquid again.) Add to the glasses, creating the second layer of color. (PRO TIP: Pour the berry blue layer around the edges rather than in the center of the glass, to prevent it from mixing with the previous layer.) Return glasses to the fridge until set, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup vanilla Greek yogurt
½ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: When the berry blue gelatin is set, add yogurt and milk to the bowl with the lemon gelatin, then whisk to combine. (If the gelatin has started to set, place in the microwave and heat in 10-second intervals, just until it is fully liquid again.) Add to the glasses, creating your final layer of color. (PRO TIP: Pour the lemon layer around the edges rather than in the center of the glass, to prevent it from mixing with the previous layer.) Return glasses to the fridge until fully set, about 4 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup vanilla Greek yogurt
½ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Just before serving, wash and dry fruit of choice (raspberries for a girl, blueberries for a boy). Pile a small handful of berries on top of each cup (making sure the berries don't touch the edges of the cups), then fully cover with whipped topping. Decorate with rainbow sprinkles.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (170 g) pkg raspberries
1 (170 g) pkg blueberries
2 (227 g) container whipped topping
¼ cup rainbow sprinkles
